episodes.title: The Too Many Rembrandts Job
episodes.summary: When the team comes together to help Sophie, they intercept guilt-ridden corporate fixer Harry and decide to help him take down an evil billionaire making money on the back of an opioid crisis.

episodes.title: The Panamanian Monkeys Job
episodes.summary: With a new team member on board plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

episodes.title: The Rollin' on the River Job
episodes.summary: The Leverage team takes on a greedy riverboat casino owner, before he can bulldoze the homes of longtime New Orleans natives for his planned expansion.

episodes.title: The Tower Job
episodes.summary: One member of the team seeks redemption and justice by convincing Leverage to con a developer out of an entire luxury apartment building.

episodes.title: The Paranormal Hacktivity Job
episodes.summary: When a woman believes she is being haunted and runs from her home in terror, Sophie leads Breanna and Parker through a con to convince the two real estate scammers responsible to target Leverage HQ.

episodes.title: The Card Game Job
episodes.summary: The Leverage team dives into the world of a high fantasy collectible card game with a devoted following to take down a pharmaceutical bad boy who is price-gouging drugs to fund his own house of cards.

episodes.title: The Double-Edged Sword Job
episodes.summary: The team takes on a brilliant software developer who is selling a groundbreaking facial recognition system that threatens everyone's privacy except his own.

episodes.title: The Mastermind Job
episodes.summary: Sophie must keep her feelings in check when she discovers that someone has written a memoir of the team, casting himself as Nate – which leads an exiled criminal to kidnap Harry and "Fake Nate," forcing the Leverage team to pull a heist.

episodes.title: The Bucket Job
episodes.summary: The Leverage team's Holiday good deed goes awry when their attempt to give a small-town librarian the spy-thriller adventure of a lifetime is interrupted by a shadowy spy organization.

episodes.title: The Unwellness Job
episodes.summary: The Leverage team sets out to discredit a lifestyle and wellness guru targeting desperate people and peddling snake oil instead of actual medicine.

episodes.title: The Jackal Job
episodes.summary: The Leverage team explores the failing memory of a legendary grifter to try and find her greatest score before her abusive Elder Guardian gets his hands on it and takes over her life.

episodes.title: The Golf Job
episodes.summary: An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

episodes.title: The Hurricane Job
episodes.summary: Stuck together during a massive hurricane, Eliot and Parker must stop a band of corrupt cops who have taken over a small hotel, and find what the cops are searching for, before it's too late.

episodes.title: The Great Train Job
episodes.summary: Two local farmers are targeted by a hate group, but something more poisonous on the farm leads Team Leverage to a crooked green energy innovator and an old-fashioned Train Heist.

episodes.title: The Muddy Waters Job
episodes.summary: The Leverage team infiltrates an oil rig and a small-town trial to find evidence that a corrupt oil CEO is hiding a dangerous oil leak in the gulf, causing illnesses along the spill zone.

episodes.title: The Harry Wilson Job
episodes.summary: The team has to infiltrate the shadowy R.I.Z. to stop it from unleashing a worm that can take down the entire electrical grid, and they must use Harry to do it.

episodes.title: The Debutante Job
episodes.summary: The team pulls Harry back into the fold to help a journalist investigating the corrupt president of a small eastern European nation. But when the journalist is grabbed, our team has to infiltrate a London Ball to extract him.

episodes.title: The One Man's Trash Job
episodes.summary: The crew finds out that a shady plastics exporter whose dumping threatens local waters is smuggling black market antiquities on his barges, and plots to relieve him of his ill-gotten gains.

episodes.title: The Tournament Job
episodes.summary: The team has to infiltrate an e-sports tournament to stop a ruthless team owner from mentally and physically abusing his young players.

episodes.title: The Date Night Job
episodes.summary: While staging a date-night experience for Parker & Hardison at an ultra-secure freeport facility, the team comes across another heist in progress and must stop it to save the life of a 13-year-old boy.

episodes.title: The Walk in the Woods Job
episodes.summary: While investigating the mysterious death of Eliot's friend, the Leverage team infiltrate an infamous enclave of power to take down the corrupt head of a Private Security Company.

episodes.title: The Fractured Job
episodes.summary: Eliot returns to his hometown and discovers that the run-off from an oil fracking company is now poisoning the water and the crew plots to take down the powerful man behind it all.

episodes.title: The Big Rig Job
episodes.summary: The team infiltrates a trucking company to stop a pair of siblings from stealing their father's company and forcing his employees into indentured servitude.

episodes.title: The Turkish Prisoner Job
episodes.summary: The team uses the true story of a World War I P.O.W. escape to free an innocent man framed by a pair of dirty cops.

episodes.title: The Pyramid Job
episodes.summary: Prompted by and old friend of Sophie's, the team takes on a husband-wife couple who run a multi-level marketing pyramid scheme that preys on young mothers, emotionally and financially.

episodes.title: The Work Study Job
episodes.summary: After a college professor steals a discovery from his grad student, the Leverage team has to take him down, returning the credit and reputation to the brilliant young woman in the process.

episodes.title: The Belly of the Beast Job
episodes.summary: The team reluctantly enlists the help of a naïve but ambitious assistant to take down a predatory music producer, in an episode told entirely from the POV of a regular person.

episodes.title: The Museum Makeover Job
episodes.summary: When a Leverage International team's museum heist goes awry, our crew goes in to finish the job, ultimately realizing they've been lured into a trap by a treacherous old friend.

episodes.title: The Crowning Achievement Job
episodes.summary: When a formidable enemy steals the Maharaja's Crown and traps the crew in the museum, the Leverage team must find a way out and the crown before they go down for the crime.

episodes.title: The Weekend in Paris Job
episodes.summary: On the run from a busted heist in Paris, the Leverage team finds themselves taking shelter among oligarchs auctioning off their home nations' precious resources. On the fly they have to create an entirely new con to take down the group's ringleader and save a well-intentioned activist.

episodes.title: The Digital Frankenstein Job
episodes.summary: The team conducts a sting to snare a corrupt judge by using the perfect undercover briber - a completely virtual tech visionary generated by A.I. - only to watch as their "Digital Frankenstein" quickly spins out of control.

episodes.title: The Scared Stiff Job
episodes.summary: Our team runs the ambitious "Christmas Carol" con on a wannabe cryonics mogul who coerces dying patients into exploitative contracts bankrupting the loved ones they leave behind. But when the mark escapes the artificial world the team has built, they must race to find his assets before the entire job is blown.

episodes.title: The Hustler Job
episodes.summary: The crew takes on a phone scamming ring that uses deepfake technology to con their marks, run by an old school hustler who came up via the pool hall circuit. To infiltrate his organization, they have to best him on and off the felt.

episodes.title: The Grand Complication Job
episodes.summary: When Sophie is abducted, rivals Parker and Astrid are forced into a desperate race against time to save her by securing the elusive "Grand Complication" Marie Antoinette watch. Unaware of each other's involvement, they embark on a high stakes quest to track her down before time runs out.

episodes.title: The Swipe Right Job
episodes.summary: Sophie's return to dating goes awry when she discovers her newest flame is a phony billionaire, swindling men and women on dating apps to fund his lavish lifestyle. To dismantle his million dollar scheme, the team must create the perfect romantic specimen and bait the ultimate catfish.

episodes.title: The Shakedown in Clone-Town Job
episodes.summary: Sophie, Eliot, and Parker get caught in a small-town speed trap run by a corrupt mayor, and decide to help the oppressed townspeople wrest power from his hungry clutches.

episodes.title: The Cooling Off the Mark Job
episodes.summary: Old friend Hurley stumbles into the path of a Mark out for vengeance on the crew. He must take point on one of the most delicate parts of the con — the Cool Off. Despite the crew's help, the situation spins out of control into a brand new con, with a brand new victim.

episodes.title: The Polygeist Job
episodes.summary: The crew pull a "Cabin in the Woods" con to take down a corrupt tech guru claiming to better the world using "effective altruism." They target his company's close-knit group of executives by turning their paranoia against them, but things get complicated when the group turns out to be much closer than they anticipated.

episodes.title: The Side Job
episodes.summary: Parker decides to take down a local factory kingpin using child labor. While the villain spins his own version of how he was wrongfully destroyed, the team tries to unravel the con Parker's running as a solo side job… or is she? The team must play catch up as they find themselves drafted into her machinations.
